example.title: Creased
lines: Every roof was once a page. Some still remember the words.
When the wind comes, the whole town rustles.
Do not get it wet.

world.title: A Portal of Shadows
lines: The air is thick with secrets.
In the distance, the moon is a spinning orb.
Do not lean too far.
As you step into the portal, the wall disappears.

world.title: Glimmer
lines: The world is quiet and peaceful.
Snowflakes dance in the air.
The sun sets in a rainbow.

world.title: Whispers
lines: The wind whispers secrets.
In the forest, the moon laughs.
Time runs slow in the midnight.
But the stars never sleep.

world.title: Wheatfield
lines: The field is a poem without words.
The stars twinkle on the wheat.
The wind whispers secrets, deep below.

world.title: Ephemeral Oasis
lines: The dew is the first sign of life
The sun whispers to play
Let the rays warm the earth
Beneath the leaves, secrets are told

world.title: Breath
lines: The morning sun's rays are warm and bright.
Birds sing sweetly as they fly.
The flowers are in full bloom.

world.title: Silent Oasis
lines: Beneath the whispering clouds, a secret whispers in the sand.
The gentle breeze carries secrets from the winds that once danced here.

world.title: Folded
lines: The sun is shining on the happy birds.
The birds are singing loudly.
The clouds are dancing in the sky.

world.title: Windswept
lines: The wind whispers secrets through the trees.
Snowflakes dance above the quiet.
Windswept, where the world hides.

world.title: Astral Plane
lines: Astral planes hold secrets of the universe.
The stars whisper to the wind.
Watching the sky, one sees the past and the future.

world.title: Dreamy
lines: The stars are playing hide and seek in the clouds.
The night gives me the sleepy feeling.
Let's snuggle under the blanket.

world.title: Mystic
lines: The whispers of the ancient city.
The sun rises, illuminating the paths.
In the distance, the forest is asleep.

world.title: butterfly garden
lines: The sun rose with a beautiful smile.
The flowers dance in the morning breeze.
The butterflies flit about in the garden.
The trees sway in the early light.

world.title: Folded
lines: A world folded in time.
Every fold brings a new story.

world.title: Silent Oasis
lines: The sun sparkles on the dew-kissed leaves.
Each whisper of the wind is a secret song.

world.title: Wetlands
lines: The sun rises over the wetlands.
Birds have nests in the grass.
The wind carries the smell of flowers.

world.title: Depth
lines: The sun is not just a life giver. It is a symbol of hope and promise.
The world is a stage where every part has a role.
The trees are the guardians of the earth. They protect us from the harmful winds and the thunderstorms.

world.title: Reflections
lines: The morning dew clings to the blades of grass.
Whispers from the shadows, soft and cool.
A gentle breeze, the scent of wildflowers.

world.title: Pineapple Fields
lines: The sun greeted the birds in the fields.
In the morning, everything woke up.
The grass grew taller.
